_comment: The frozen guard fileset. Content-hashed into gate-manifest.lock.json; gates.cjs gate-freeze fails on drift, engine/hooks/gate-freeze.cjs denies a write to any of these from a session whose cwd is outside harnessRoots. Relative paths resolve from this repository's root; a trailing `#key` hashes one top-level JSON key. Extra machine-specific roots and frozen files go in <claude home>/overlay/gates.json ({harnessRoots, frozen}), never here. Relock deliberately: node tools/gates/gates.cjs --lock
